played.scene:
# The Cathedral of decks (#188) – a deck: the set `cathedral` from Cat Pope chapter 2 – the sermon's cathedral (the owner's
# Unreal export, agents/research/LOCATION-SCENES.md §7) – and this deck's being floating in the nave: its graph as a
# body, node points with their parameters as 3D buttons, the links as hoses with bubbles, its head the character's
# portrait (phase 5). With a relay set (deck.toml `relay` or --relay) it joins the session as a deck (`join` below) and
# streams its being to the conductor (scenes/conductor.toml). Run it:
#   cargo run --release -p deck-native -- --scene cathedral --windowed
# (the sync fetches the set and the portraits into the cache; local copies instead: --sets ../media/scutoons/rooms
#  --portraits ../media/characters)
# Mouse: drag = turn the camera (or a button's value), wheel = zoom; ← → turn, ↑ ↓ zoom, R the camera's home.

[stage]
name = "Cathedral of decks"
render_scale = 1.0

# the being's shape (space/being.rs; the colours are the space node's hue / glow below) and its head: the character
# whose portrait mood sprites it wears (<character>_portrait-<mood>.png under --portraits); `moods` = calm → wild, the
# energy (the FFT level, the tempo) walks through them
[being]
character = "catpope"
moods = ["neutral", "thinking", "happy", "laughing", "surprised"]
size = 0.5
drift = 0.06
breath = 0.04
wobble = 0.025

# feedback → emotion (space/feel.rs): a rule reads `when` (node.port – the node by id, else by kind -, bpm, touch,
# energy, phrase = 0..8 through an 8-bar phrase), tests it (above / below, rising / falling = a jump over the last half
# second, steady = moved less than `by` for that many s) and shows its mood for at least `hold` s; the heaviest
# `weight` wins, a mood shown 6 s rests `cooldown` s (4); none firing = the energy's ladder above. Arbitrary on purpose
# (owner 2026-10-30: "the main thing is that we get a change") – every mood of the set has one.
feel = [
  { mood = "smug", when = "touch", above = 0.5, weight = 6 },
  { mood = "embarrassed", when = "touch", falling = 0.3, weight = 6, hold = 2 },
  { mood = "dizzy", when = "strain", above = 0.4, weight = 7, hold = 2 },
  { mood = "dizzy", when = "sway.shape", rising = 0.5, weight = 6, hold = 3 },
  { mood = "surprised", when = "fft.bass", rising = 0.12, weight = 5, hold = 1.2 },
  { mood = "scared", when = "fft.level", rising = 0.2, weight = 5 },
  { mood = "angry", when = "fft.high", rising = 0.08, weight = 4, hold = 1 },
  { mood = "dying", when = "fft.level", below = 0.015, for = 1.5, weight = 4 },
  { mood = "tripping", when = "sway.rate", above = 0.8, weight = 4 },
  { mood = "furious", when = "voice.index", above = 4.5, weight = 3 },
  { mood = "confused", when = "voice.ratio", above = 2.2, weight = 3 },
  { mood = "crying", when = "fft.level", falling = 0.15, weight = 3 },
  { mood = "laughing", when = "bpm", above = 104, weight = 2 },
  { mood = "happy", when = "fft.mid", above = 0.3, for = 1, weight = 2, chance = 0.5, cooldown = 12 },
  { mood = "disgusted", when = "incense.cutoff", below = 800, weight = 2 },
  { mood = "denial", when = "phrase", above = 7, weight = 2 },
  { mood = "bargaining", when = "phrase", above = 3, below = 3.5, weight = 2, chance = 0.6 },
  { mood = "sad", when = "fft.bass", below = 0.04, for = 2 },
  { mood = "thinking", when = "fft.level", steady = 3, by = 0.06 },
  { mood = "acceptance", when = "energy", steady = 5, by = 0.08 },
  { mood = "neutral", when = "phrase", below = 0.25 },
]
# emotion → sound: when the head turns to `mood`, `set` (an unlinked input) is kicked `by` / `to` over `attack` s
# (0.25) and eases back over `release` s (2) – several chain into the rules above (surprised → furious, laughing →
# tripping, smug → confused). Gentle on the sound (#188, owner 2026-10-31: the nudges sounded like dropouts): no gain
# ducks deeper than 6 dB, the sound's attacks take ≥ 0.15 s, dying fades instead of falling silent; the output
# limiter straining makes it dizzy (`strain`)
react = [
  { mood = "neutral", set = "space.light", by = 0.15, release = 3 },
  { mood = "thinking", set = "voice.index", by = -1.2, attack = 0.5, release = 4 },
  { mood = "thinking", set = "mix.gain4", by = -0.5, attack = 0.5, release = 4 },
  { mood = "happy", set = "space.hue", by = 0.12, release = 3 },
  { mood = "happy", set = "sway.depth", by = 0.5, release = 3 },
  { mood = "laughing", set = "seq.rate", by = 1, attack = 0.3, release = 4 },
  { mood = "laughing", set = "sway.rate", by = 0.9, release = 4 },
  { mood = "smug", set = "voice.ratio", by = 0.8, release = 3 },
  { mood = "smug", set = "space.glow", by = 0.3, release = 2 },
  { mood = "surprised", set = "space.glow", by = 0.6, attack = 0.03, release = 0.8 },
  { mood = "surprised", set = "drone.freq", by = 20, attack = 0.15, release = 0.8 },
  { mood = "surprised", set = "voice.index", by = 3, release = 2 },
  { mood = "scared", set = "space.light", by = -0.4, attack = 0.05, release = 1.5 },
  { mood = "scared", set = "incense.gain", by = 0.05, attack = 0.3, release = 1.5 },
  { mood = "furious", set = "space.hue", to = 0.0, attack = 0.2, release = 3 },
  { mood = "furious", set = "space.glow", by = 0.5, release = 3 },
  { mood = "furious", set = "voice.gain", by = 0.05, attack = 0.3, release = 2 },
  { mood = "angry", set = "drone.freq", by = -10, attack = 0.3, release = 1.5 },
  { mood = "angry", set = "space.hue", to = 0.03, release = 1.5 },
  { mood = "disgusted", set = "space.hue", to = 0.22, release = 3 },
  { mood = "disgusted", set = "voice.ratio", by = 1.27, release = 2.5 },
  { mood = "embarrassed", set = "space.hue", to = 0.95, release = 2.5 },
  { mood = "embarrassed", set = "voice.gain", by = -0.08, attack = 0.4, release = 2 },
  { mood = "confused", set = "seq.rate", by = -0.5, release = 3 },
  { mood = "confused", set = "sway.depth", by = -0.6, release = 3 },
  { mood = "dizzy", set = "sway.rate", by = 1.5, release = 4 },
  { mood = "dizzy", set = "space.light", by = -0.2, release = 2 },
  { mood = "tripping", set = "space.hue", by = 0.5, attack = 1, release = 5 },
  { mood = "tripping", set = "voice.ratio", by = 0.75, release = 4 },
  { mood = "sad", set = "space.hue", to = 0.64, release = 4 },
  { mood = "sad", set = "music.gain", by = -0.2, attack = 0.8, release = 4 },
  { mood = "crying", set = "voice.index", by = -1.5, release = 3 },
  { mood = "crying", set = "space.glow", by = -0.3, release = 3 },
  { mood = "dying", set = "space.light", by = -0.5, attack = 1, release = 4 },
  { mood = "dying", set = "drone.freq", by = -6, attack = 1.5, release = 4 },
  { mood = "dying", set = "voice.gain", by = -0.06, attack = 1.5, release = 4 },
  { mood = "denial", set = "mix.gain1", by = -0.5, attack = 0.4, release = 1.8 },
  { mood = "bargaining", set = "voice.ratio", by = -0.5, release = 3 },
  { mood = "bargaining", set = "seq.rate", by = 0.5, release = 3 },
  { mood = "acceptance", set = "space.glow", by = -0.2, release = 5 },
  { mood = "acceptance", set = "space.light", by = 0.1, release = 5 },
]

id = "tempo"

bpm = 84

# the show clock (#321): the conductor leads, the decks follow; without a leader on the relay it runs on at 84

# the sermon's chapter: its music under everything (cached; offline the rest still plays)

[[node]]

volume = 0.8

# the space: the set by id (its 3D at `quality`: <sets>/cathedral/cathedral.<quality>.glb, synced from the API), where
# the being floats (`at` in the set's metres – in the nave, ahead of the reader's view; or `spot` = a spot of the set +
# `lift`), the camera's start (yaw / pitch in degrees, distance in metres – yaw 279 looks the way the reader's view
# does); hue / glow colour the being, light dims the set, pulse kicks its light; `join` = how it takes part in a session with a relay set (deck · conductor ·
# alone)
[[node]]
id = "space"
kind = "space"
set = "cathedral"
quality = "low"
at = [2.4, 0.2, 5.2]
yaw = 279
pitch = 6
distance = 2.4
hue = 0.52
glow = 0.6
light = 0.85
join = "deck"
# the post stack (#204, deck-space post.rs): passes in this order after the space is drawn – bloom, curves (lift /
# gamma / gain), pixelate (block size in render pixels, `levels` per channel, or `palette` = ["#rrggbb", …]), FXAA. Their
# knobs are the space node's control inputs (link them, nudge them from `react`); one at neutral costs nothing (curves at
# 0 / 1 / 1, pixel 1 without levels or palette), a pass not listed doesn't exist
post = ["bloom", "curves", "pixelate", "fxaa"]
bloom = 0.6
threshold = 0.55
# the being's core lights the room (#204): `glow_range` (m) how far, `glow_light` how strong (0 = off) – its colour the
# hue, its strength glow + the level's pulse

played.scene:
# The silent scene (#425, owner 2026-11-08: "eine figur ohne rig, sollte nicht klingen. weil ja kein rig"): what a deck
# plays when no rig does – the being in its space and the window's screen, NO audio graph at all. deck-space's
# `Played::silent` is the deck's own scene (`Deck::new`); the picture stays, the sound does not. Its space node is bare
# like a rig's: the room is the platform's (the native `staged` puts the deck's room around it, the browser asks
# `Deck::room`). The Cathedral (cathedral.toml) is a TEST scene now: `--scene cathedral`, F5.
[stage]
name = "silent"

[[node]]
id = "space"
kind = "space"

[[node]]
id = "screen"
kind = "screen"

[[link]]
from = "space"
to = "screen.in"
